definitions.gloss: to be naughty, to act up, to misbehave
definitions.explanation: Describes childish misbehavior or playful troublemaking, typically by children.

definitions.gloss: to be wild, to raise hell, to get into trouble
definitions.explanation: When used about teenagers or young adults, describes rebellious or delinquent behavior, often looking back on it nostalgically.

examples.english: My kid is always acting up.

⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やんちゃして、⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落書|らくが}き→落書き：14043_rakugaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
The noun form ⟦やんちゃ→やんちゃ：09359_yancha⟧ can also be used as a な-adjective: ⟦やんちゃ→やんちゃ：09359_yancha⟧な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (a naughty child).

When adults describe their own past ⟦やんちゃ→やんちゃ：09359_yancha⟧, it often carries a nostalgic or self-deprecating tone, sometimes even a hint of pride in having been rebellious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦やんちゃ→やんちゃ：09359_yancha⟧な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: a naughty/rambunctious kid
- ⟦やんちゃ→やんちゃ：09359_yancha⟧{盛|ざか}り: at the peak of mischievous age
- {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やんちゃ→やんちゃ：09359_yancha⟧: youthful wildness
